source.text: 大荒之中，有山名曰北極天櫃，海水北注焉。有神，九首人面鳥身，名曰九鳳。

inferred.item: 恰九颗人面、鸟身；九颈分前五后四为排布推断
inferred.basis: 正文明确「九首人面鸟身」，不保留额外鸟首，也不加人体肩胸。前五后四的层次、颈长曲度、人面尺寸、成人须发与具体五官均属造型补足，原文未规定性别、年龄或发式。

inferred.item: 双翼、双足和单束禽尾为鸟类解剖补足
inferred.basis: 原文只记鸟身，未列翼、足、尾的数量与形态；据普通禽鸟补出双翼双足、一束普通尾羽及羽褶肩颈，不增称九尾或火羽。

inferred.item: 青灰羽、自然肤色和深发为艺术设色
inferred.basis: 该条未记颜色、冠饰或纹样；统一青灰禽羽与暖肤深发、羽褶纹理均为推断，不借九婴、鬼车、九头虫或后世神职补史。

inferred.item: 九首错相轻转、短跃舒翼与九声低鸣为动作拟声
inferred.basis: 经文未记九凤鸣声与动作，呼吸、双足短跃、九首独立轻转、舒翼及九个错落音符都只作展示演绎；不另赋火焰、水法、婚配或地域神职。

references.note: 采用本底本「海水北注焉。有神，九首人面鳥身」的连续原文；山名为北極天櫃。
独立交叉核对九首、人面、鸟身、九凤及山名；该页作「海外北注焉」，櫃附一作樻校注，异文不拼入所用底本引文。

production.method: two independently verified HIGH masters, offline shoulder removal and headless bird remodeling, original nine feather necks and shoulder ruff; zero new generation transactions

masters.note: Returned filename says basic_pbr; actual job/ledger tier is Extreme-High and the file contains exactly 50,000 triangles. The unrelated 9,999,998-triangle model_export_raw.glb is not used.

production.changes: preserve HIGH faces but remove generated human shoulders with prepare_guardian_head.py; broaden avian shoulders, remove native bird head, cap and cover removal plane with an original feather ruff; nine individually weighted curved feather necks meet short human neck stumps; human heads are effect-mounted cloned scenes with body-relative inverse rest rotation; positive scales only

parentAudit.resources: useMemo only clones owned scenes and creates mixers/holders; effect installs reversible ink materials/outlines and mounts nine heads with body-relative rest rotations. Cleanup removes/restores/disposes owned resources.
parentAudit.method: 155 real rendered frames per action; CPU-skinned sole world XYZ displacement and sole direction, nine independently moving head mounts, six remount cycles with seven snapshots.
parentAudit.checks: Stable nine human heads, nine holders and necks, 55 bones, 20 surfaces and 20 outlines; head-root offset below 7e-16m. Actual 105.795875s narration advances without media error; nine cry oscillators, nonzero SFX RMS, narration stop and special return verified. No browser errors. Four concept views and final three poses/six motion closeups inspected.
parentAudit.narrationLayout: Shared transcript defaults to a 45px collapsed details panel, expandable by the viewer; full text remains readable and both stop controls work. Desktop/tablet/phone layout checks are browser emulation, not hardware performance benchmarks.
